scope: Actual compiled daemon/CLI and Windows Chrome on disposable instance; complete catalogue, settings CAS/activation/template/undo, canonical graph currency and scoped jobs. Queued scan producer is explicitly declared; no inference, live migration, global install or platform Computer Use claim.

focused.name: serves the exact canonical core context with an unattested external receipt and rejects oversized input
the actual VSCode client validates the generated canonical pack and preserves an HTTP failure
oversized model-facing results retain mandatory graph receipts, mutation uncertainty and errors as whole JSON
prose compaction cannot remove required ADR/graph anchors or alter literal tool source
timeout of a streaming response cannot cancel another request; disposal cancels all outstanding bodies
maps every consumed setting to one typed control or named read-only exception without leaking stored secrets
keeps invalid drafts and keyboard tab state, then saves an independent zero limit without enabling work
edits structured component settings and retains explicit zeros/default inheritance through restart parsing
retains a whole captured save after a committed lost reply and recovers that receipt without a second effect
keeps drafts on concurrent revision refusal and never overwrites the intervening file
previews a scoped template without writes, applies protected staging and undoes the original bytes
generic apply refreshes actual cached model controls and daemon role readback without touching session overrides
structured edits remove only corresponding legacy aliases and preserve unrelated zero limits
a runtime activation failure preserves the committed save, restores prior runtime and excludes secret error text
recent and active pagination retains session isolation and refuses cancellation of another session job
preserves fragmented UTF-8 configuration bytes and rejects invalid encoding before any file write
reports a staged deletion as a mismatch until restart clears the old runtime override
root runtime uses canonical currency and shows actual scoped queued cancellation without inventing stop or retry
schema-derived action fields and draft preview validate without creating files/jobs or changing definitions
duplicate is atomic/new/disabled and original receipt replays after later source edits
enable and enqueue bind reviewed policy; lost replies replay originals rather than applying new ambient policy
actual served browser script saves disabled, preserves invalid drafts, and supports keyboard tabs/filter/edit
captured menu targets survive selection changes and stale edits fail while source history survives
captured schedule navigation opens the exact draft or run preview without mutating definitions or enqueueing work
stale captured schedule navigation shows inspection and never opens or dispatches a replacement action
missing captured schedule navigation retains an honest unavailable selection rather than opening another definition

checks.name: CW01
checks.detail: Root has working Explorer/Architect navigation and actual canonical graph/queued scan status. The queued producer does not claim a dispatched scan.

checks.name: CW02
checks.detail: Actual original-fence queued cancellation commits without claiming running work stopped or dispatching a retry.

checks.name: CW03
checks.detail: Every supported setting maps to a typed control or named read-only exception; global search reveals imported redacted values without writes.

checks.name: CW04
checks.detail: Model suggestions consume the current core provider registry and still permit explicit adapter-qualified identifiers.

checks.name: CW05
checks.detail: Keyboard tabs retain invalid drafts and accessible field errors; exact zero limits remain zero.

checks.name: CW06
checks.detail: Structured component edits remove only their corresponding legacy alias and preserve unrelated zero/paused policy.

checks.name: CW07
checks.detail: Committed lost save acknowledgement recovers the original request/receipt after readback, with no second mutation or unrelated scheduler activation.

checks.name: CW08
checks.detail: A concurrent save is refused without overwriting intervening intent; drafts remain until explicitly discarded/rebased.

checks.name: CW09
checks.detail: Scoped template preview writes nothing, apply stages protected intent and exact undo restores original config bytes without touching graph data.

checks.name: CW10
checks.detail: Actual narrow layout and forced-colors keyboard navigation remain usable with visible selection, draft/errors and bounded geometry.

checks.name: CW11
checks.detail: Computer Use configuration is finite setup, not an execution grant or platform qualification; actual role allocations remain zero.

checks.name: CW12
checks.detail: Offline readback retains the known settings/drafts and shows failure; reconnect reloads authoritative values.

checks.name: CW13
checks.detail: Actual compiled daemon stop/start activates a staged removal and readback clears the saved/effective mismatch while preserving graph bytes. Browser never claims the CLI command already ran.

checks.name: CW14
checks.detail: Actual compiled CLI reaches this isolated restarted daemon; server metadata is pinned to the local compiled build.

checks.name: CW15
checks.detail: Schedule navigation reuses the existing workspace and canonical job/debt authority; six effective model allocations remain zero.

compound.XS06: Actual zero/alias/model activation plus unchanged original job admission and shared tests.
compound.XS07: Scoped protected template preview/apply/undo and separate saved/effective activation; actual restart readback.
compound.XS12: Actual keyboard tabs, retained validation, narrow/forced-colors and shared schedule workspace.
compound.XS21: Canonical mutation/full-scan/reconciliation/debt are separate; no scan-age staleness or hidden scan request.

limits: Queued scan fixture qualifies authoritative job state/cancel, not dispatched scan or numerical substep progress.
Provider, native GUI, other-platform and paired model-understanding evidence remain owning Slice31/27 gates.
Product remains13.4.0 until Slice28. The existing509 editor cases are unchanged; actual editor/client HTTP integration participates in the current root run.
